description:
Hey everyone! I'm building a team to create a space mission game for this year's Space Apps Challenge. I love game design, orbital mechanics, sci-fi, and cats.

Why Join: We're focusing on a clear, achievable mechanic (a minimum viable product) that showcases real NASA data in a fun way.

Looking For: Programmers, UI/UX designers, and anyone good at storytelling or working with open NASA APIs. All skill levels welcome—let's build something awesome together!
